## About
Robert's Automotive Repairs is a small business in Lewisville, TX. Our word is our bond. When your vehicle comes in, we'll tell you which repairs are critical and which can wait, so you can decide what makes sense for you.
Robert and the team, including Willie, handle everyday maintenance like oil changes, brakes and A/C, along with the harder jobs, from check engine lights to electrical problems. Our ASE Master Certified technicians work with high tech diagnostic equipment.
We're rated 4.7 from 88 Google reviews. Open Monday through Friday. Give us a call or request an appointment online.

## Services
- Oil Changes: Regular oil changes to keep your engine running right. (Starting at $79.99)
- Free Tire Rotation with Oil Change: We rotate your tires at no charge when you come in for an oil change.
- Free Vehicle Inspections: Bring it in and we'll look it over at no charge.
- Brake Packages: Brake work for when your stops don't feel right. (Starting at $179.99)
- A/C Recharges: Get your air conditioning blowing cold again. (Starting at $99.99)
- Coolant Flushes: Fresh coolant to help keep your engine from running hot. (Starting at $129.99)
- High Tech Diagnostic Equipment: We use high tech diagnostic equipment to track down problems like a check engine light that keeps coming on.
- Maintenance Recommendations: We'll let you know what maintenance your vehicle needs and what can wait.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 to 6:00. We're closed on weekends.

Q: Do you work with warranty companies?
A: Yes. We work with all warranty companies.

Q: How do I request an appointment?
A: Call us or fill out the request form with your name, contact info, the year, make and model of your vehicle, and the services you need.
